Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier — appreciate you walking us through Silverline's use case. Quick recap and next steps on the procurement side so your team has everything you need to start vendor setup: 

- Docs we typically provide: vendor setup packet (attached), Redwood W-9, company bank ACH form for direct deposit.
- Questions for your procurement/finance team: do you prefer issuing a PO (Net30) or paying by card for an initial pilot? Also let us know if you need insurance certificates or a reseller agreement.
- Marketplace: you mentioned listing on your internal marketplace — are you looking for AWS Marketplace/SaaS Marketplace listing or just internal vendor enablement? We can share the marketplace packet if helpful.

Next steps I suggest:
1) If you can confirm preferred payment method (PO vs card) and billing contact, we'll return the W-9 + vendor packet and any additional forms.
2) We'll send the vendor packet and W-9 to procurement@silverlineretail.com (attached).
3) If you have a vendor portal link, please share it and we'll submit directly there.

Attached: vendor_setup_form.pdf (fillable PDF)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with your procurement lead if that helps move this along.

Best,

Thanks Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few items from procurement side:

- Payment preference: we prefer PO / Net30 for vendors of this size. For small one-off purchases teams will use card but strategic vendor relationships go on PO.
- Required docs: completed vendor packet + W-9 + bank ACH form (for ACH payments). We also will ask for COI and proof of SOC2 if available.
- Vendor portal: please submit through our vendor portal so Finance can kick off the onboarding workflow. Portal link: https://vendors.silverlineretail.com/portal/12345 (registration required).
- Timeline: typical vendor setup 10-14 business days after we receive complete paperwork; we can expedite to ~5 business days for pilots if we get all required docs up-front.

We are also interested in marketplace options (AWS Marketplace) but will need legal/contract confirmation before listing.

I've cc'd Maya (billing) — she will be the billing contact for this engagement.

Alex Turner
Procurement Manager | Silverline Retail
